summary: The registrant, TPG Twin Brook Capital Income Fund, filed a Form 8-K to disclose entry into a Third Supplement to its Master Note Purchase Agreement, issuing $225 million aggregate principal amount of Series D Senior Notes in a private placement. The notes consist of $50 million 6.67% Tranche A Notes due 2029 and $175 million 7.03% Tranche B Notes due 2031. The filing reports routine debt financing, not a special situation. No special-situation category applies.
